null.settings.screen.title: NULL settings
null.settings.screen.all_options.tooltip: Opens NeoForge's full configuration screen for NULL, including the world settings when you are allowed to change them.
null.settings.screen_shake_intensity.too: How strongly the screen and camera may shake. 0% turns shaking off completely.
null.settings.reduce_screen_shake.toolti: Cuts all screen shaking and sudden camera movement down to a small fraction, whatever the slider above says.
null.settings.flashing_intensity.tooltip: How strong flashes, flicker and blackouts may be. At 0% they are replaced by slow fades, on NULL's desktop windows too.
null.settings.disable_intense_effects.to: Turns off freezes, strobing, colour storms and other intense visual effects, and keeps flashing low.
null.settings.max_visual_effects.tooltip: The most screen distortion effects that may run at the same time. Lower it if the screen gets too busy or the game slows down; 0 turns them off.
null.settings.shader_effects.tooltip: Use NULL's post-processing effects (colour separation, colour shifts, glitches). Turn this off if they clash with other mods or shader packs.
null.settings.horror_sounds.tooltip: Master switch for all of NULL's horror sounds. The audio options below only apply while this is on.
null.settings.audio_intensity.tooltip: How loud and how strong the audio corruption is.
null.settings.phantom_footsteps.tooltip: Footsteps that are not your own.
null.settings.music_distortion.tooltip: Music that is distorted or replaced.
null.settings.pitch_distortion.tooltip: Ordinary game sounds played at the wrong pitch.
null.settings.sudden_silence.tooltip: Moments where every sound suddenly stops.
null.settings.custom_main_menu.tooltip: Show NULL's corrupted title screen. Turn it off to get the normal Minecraft menu back.
null.settings.animated_background.toolti: Let the corrupted menu's background move.
null.settings.background_animation_inten: How much the menu background moves.
null.settings.menu_glitch_intensity.tool: How often and how strongly the corrupted menu glitches.
null.settings.menu_sounds.tooltip: Ambience and interface sounds in the corrupted menu.
null.settings.desktop_interference.toolt: Lets NULL show small, clearly labelled windows outside the game window while you play. Switching it on first explains exactly what that means; switching it off closes every window at once. Not available on macOS.
null.settings.desktop_notifications.tool: Allow small notifications in the corners of the screen and short distorted messages.
null.settings.desktop_error_windows.tool: Allow NULL's larger error windows and reports.
null.settings.desktop_frequency.tooltip: How often desktop windows may appear. There is always a pause between two windows (set below), and never more than three at once.
null.settings.forget_stage.tooltip: The main menu remembers the furthest stage this computer has seen (currently stage %s) and looks worse the further it went. Forgetting it calms the menu down again. No world is changed.
null.settings.desktop_status.fullscreen: on, paused while the game is in fullscreen
null.settings.desktop_status.failed: could not open windows on this computer
null.settings.desktop_test.tooltip: Shows one desktop window right now so you can see what it looks like. Each press shows a different kind.
null.settings.desktop_test.checking: Checking this computer first; the test window follows.
null.settings.desktop_test.unavailable: Desktop windows are not available on this computer.
null.settings.desktop_test.fullscreen: Not while the game is in fullscreen.
null.desktop.footer: NULL · Minecraft mod · click to close
null.desktop.consent.title: Desktop interference
null.desktop.consent.intro: NULL can show small windows outside the Minecraft window, on your desktop, while you play: short messages such as "ERROR 804 - INFORMATION : NULL." in white text on black. They are part of the horror, nothing more.
null.desktop.consent.point.when: - They only appear while you are in a world: very rarely at first, more often as the world gets worse.
null.desktop.consent.point.label: - Every window is labelled "%s".
null.desktop.consent.point.close: - Click a window, or press Esc in the game, to close it. Each one also closes by itself after a few seconds, and all of them close when you leave the world or quit the game.
null.desktop.consent.point.input: - They never take your keyboard or mouse, never cover the whole screen and never appear while the game is in fullscreen.
null.desktop.consent.point.nothing: - Nothing on your computer is changed, and nothing is collected or sent anywhere.
null.desktop.consent.point.off: - You can switch this off again in NULL's settings at any time.
null.configuration.title: NULL - all options
null.settings.desktop_cooldown.tooltip: The shortest pause between two desktop windows.
null.settings.desktop_chance_notificatio: Type A: small notifications in a corner of the desktop. 100% is normal; Never turns them off.
null.settings.desktop_chance_error.toolt: Type B: small NULL error windows, from Stage 3. 100% is normal; Never turns them off.
null.settings.desktop_chance_distorted.t: Type C: a short message that flickers and disappears, from Stage 3. 100% is normal; Never turns them off.
null.settings.desktop_chance_report.tool: Type D: larger windows with several lines of text, from Stage 4. 100% is normal; Never turns them off.
null.settings.desktop_chance_final.toolt: Type E: Stage 5 only. 100% is normal; Never turns them off.
